title: Understanding foreign ATM fees for teens
summary: Explains foreign ATM withdrawal fees for Light Green accounts: $2.00 per withdrawal for up to and including $100, $3.50 for more than $100 up to and including $300, and $5.00 for above $300. Fee is charged per successful withdrawal based on the amount dispensed and is separate from any ATM operator fee.
